title: 01. Where Is Everyone Going?
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: The morning sun sparkled, and Hori was excited. Today he would play with his friends all day. Let's play together! With his toy car in hand, Hori skipped out of the house.
First came Toto's house. Toto, let's play with cars! But Toto seemed busy, brushing their teeth and washing up. Sorry, I'm busy right now!
Next came Bori's house. Bori, let's go look at flowers! But Bori was busy, too, combing their hair neatly and changing into clean clothes. Sorry, I'm busy right now!
Now it was Kongi's turn. Kongi, let's build a sandcastle! But Kongi was busy gathering supplies and putting on a yellow backpack. Sorry, I'm busy right now!
Last came Dubu. Dubu, let's have a race! But Dubu was busy, too, lining up with Mom in front of a yellow bus. Woof! Sorry, I'm busy, too!
Hori felt sad. Where is everyone going? Why am I the only one left out? His shoulders drooped, and the toy car hung loosely in his hand.
Then Hori saw where the yellow bus stopped. It was a building with a colorful rainbow sign! Toto, Bori, Kongi, and Dubu all went inside. Oh! They're all going to preschool!
Songs and laughter drifted out of the preschool. Everyone was drawing and building with blocks. It looked so much fun! I want to play there, too! Hori's eyes sparkled.
Hori ran home and hugged Mom tightly. Mom! I want to go to preschool, too! Mom smiled and stroked his head. Yes, Hori. You'll join the Rainbow Class tomorrow!

That night, Hori could hardly sleep. What would the Rainbow Class be like? What would he play with his friends? Tomorrow I'll be in the Rainbow Class, too! Under the covers, Hori smiled with excitement.
